scores.claim_text: BigBear.ai is a federal contractor whose customers are primarily DoD/national-security agencies
scores.M_value: 8 UEIs resolved (BigBear.ai Federal LLC, Ask Sage, ProModel Government Solutions, ProModel Corp, Open Solutions Group); 138 contracts totaling $142.5M obligated; 78 DoD contracts (largest agency); also GSA, DHS, VA, HHS, Ex-Im Bank. signal=RECURRING_FEDERAL.
scores.interpretation: Federal contractor status fully corroborated. DoD is dominant agency (78/138). Subsidiary roll-up (Pangiam not appearing as separate UEI, but Ask Sage shows $19.8M FY snapshot and ProModel Govt Solutions $14M ARFORGEN tooling) shows broad federal footprint consistent with thesis.

scores.claim_text: ConductorOS was central to Talisman Sabre 2025 joint exercise (U.S./Australian + 24 nations)
scores.M_check: edgar_fts.query_fulltext(search_term='ConductorOS') Mode A + edgar_fts(search_term='Talisman Sabre') Mode B
scores.M_value: ConductorOS: 9 hits, ALL from BigBear.ai's own 8-K/DEF 14A/10-K filings (no third-party). Talisman Sabre: 1 hit, ONLY in BBAI's own 10-K. usaspending shows no contract Description containing 'Talisman' or 'ConductorOS'. BigBear.ai Federal's $4.3M Orion DSP Tradewinds contract (W519TC25C0017) is the closest plausible vehicle.
scores.interpretation: ConductorOS exists as a real product brand (mentioned across multiple BBAI filings since 2023), but the specific Talisman Sabre 2025 claim has zero independent registry corroboration (no third-party SEC filer mentions it, no contract line item names it). Plausible but unverifiable from neutral sources — MODERATE because product itself is real and the exercise itself is well-known, but BBAI's centrality is self-attested only.

scores.claim_text: Three-acquisition rollup (Pangiam, Ask Sage $271.6M, CargoSeer $5M) coherent with defense AI thesis
scores.M_value: mean_coherence=0.81, all three rated high_coherence (0.85/0.85/0.72). signal=COHERENT_ROLLUP. n_low_coherence=0, n_revenue_synthetic=0. Ask Sage usaspending presence ($19.8M FY snapshot, $10.9M DoD CIO G6 task order) corroborates Mode A.
scores.interpretation: Rollup is thematically coherent (biometrics/border + gen-AI + cargo NII all map to national-security and travel/trade verticals BBAI claims). NOT the Nikola/AHC pattern of incoherent diversification. Ask Sage in particular shows real federal traction independently. PASS.

scores.claim_text: Patent portfolio in AI/biometrics/edge/digital-identity (U.S. and abroad)
scores.M_check: uspto_odp.query_assignee for BigBear.ai, Pangiam, ProModel, Ask Sage (Mode A + Mode B)
scores.M_value: BigBear.ai: 1 application (18219084, vulnerability-detection, Notice of Allowance Mailed pre-grant), 0 granted. Pangiam: 0 applications. ProModel: 0 applications. Ask Sage: 0 applications. Total granted across all entities through cutoff: 0.
scores.interpretation: Filing language hedges ('not dependent on any particular patent') so this is not a Nikola/Quantumscape-class material misstatement. But the explicit 'patent protection in the United States and abroad' claim is materially overstated — zero granted U.S. patents at parent or any acquired entity, and zero applications at Pangiam/ProModel/Ask Sage. Per heuristic 8 (PASS only if n_granted >= 5), this is MODERATE. Not RED because company language is appropriately vague.

scores.claim_text: $637M raised via ATM in 2025, 142M shares issued, share count 251.5M -> 437.0M (74% dilution)
scores.M_value: Mode A: 11 S-3/424B5/424B3 filings 2023-2025 confirm shelf and prospectus supplements. Mode B insider sales query (in-flight; deferred). Self-disclosed dilution is consistent with prospectus filings on file (S-3 effective Apr 2023; updated Jan 2025; 424B5 supplements May 2024, Jun 2025, Aug 2025 implied).
scores.interpretation: ATM raise is real and consistent with public SEC filings. 74% share-count expansion is severe dilution but is disclosed cleanly and was an explicit corporate strategy (the company touts the resulting balance-sheet improvement: $50M -> $461M cash). PASS for disclosure accuracy; the dilution itself is a fundamental risk factor but not a verification failure.

scores.claim_text: Six leased offices: McLean VA HQ + Ann Arbor MI, Chantilly VA, Columbia MD, London UK, Abu Dhabi UAE
scores.M_value: EPA FRS: 0 facilities matching 'BigBear' in VA — expected per heuristic 1 (light office/SaaS, not EPA-regulated). OSHA query returned a non-filtered dump of 398k generic records (no BigBear establishment matches in the visible window). H-1B LCA: 0 filings matching 'BigBear' in available 2024 Q3 window.
scores.interpretation: BigBear.ai is a software/professional-services firm with no industrial-process footprint — registries that detect facilities (EPA FRS, OSHA Form 300A) wouldn't be expected to register it. H-1B data window does not cover the recent period for which BBAI hires. Genuine coverage gap — UNVERIFIABLE per heuristic 1.

scores.claim_text: ICFR effective as of Dec 31 2025 after remediation of previously-disclosed material weakness in technical accounting
scores.M_value: Post-filing window (2026-03-03 to 2026-05-20): 1 subsequent 8-K mentions 'material weakness' (1Q26 earnings release, May 5 2026). evolution_status=MENTIONED_INCIDENTALLY, classification all zero. No adverse findings identified. Ask Sage carve-out from ICFR assessment (acquired Dec 31, 2025 — Day 1 acquired entity excluded per SEC rules) is standard and not a red flag.
scores.interpretation: Self-attested remediation; auditor (Grant Thornton) issued opinion. But the fact that BBAI HAD a material weakness in technical accounting through 2024 and only completed remediation by 2026 filing is a recurring control-quality concern — historical material-weakness pattern is documented in prior filings (2024 10-K disclosed it). The Ask Sage carve-out (acquired same day as fiscal year-end) is technically permissible but means 4% of total assets are unattested. MODERATE per heuristic — not RED because remediation is disclosed and dated, but a clean-history company would have no flag.
